config.default.format.description: Default archive format used when compressing files.
config.default.format.tar.gz: TAR + GZip — compressed archive with directory structure
config.default.format.tar.bz2: TAR + BZip2 — high compression with directory structure
config.default.format.tar.xz: TAR + XZ — best compression with directory structure
config.default.format.tar.zst: TAR + Zstandard — fast compression with directory structure
config.default.format.tar.lz4: TAR + LZ4 — fastest compression with directory structure
config.default.format.tar.br: TAR + Brotli — high compression ratio with directory structure
config.default.format.tar.sz: TAR + Snappy — fastest compression with directory structure
config.limits.maxArchiveSize.description: Max archive size (incl. split volumes). Exceeding it warns before the WASM fallback loads the archive into memory (extraction/preview can continue after confirmation). Units: k/m/g. Default '1g'.
config.limits.maxExtractTotalSize.descri: Max total size of all files in one extraction. Units: k/m/g. Default '10g'.
config.extractTo.enabled.description: Show the 'Extract to…' command (pick a destination folder). Off by default — extracting into an arbitrary folder can scatter files.
config.patterns.collapsedDirs.descriptio: Directory name patterns kept collapsed by default in the archive preview.
config.patterns.compressExclude.descript: Glob patterns (gitignore syntax) excluded when compressing.
config.volumes.sizes.description: Custom split-volume size presets (label → value). Values: positive integer + unit (`k`/`m`/`g`), e.g. `"650M"`, `"100m"`. Empty `{}` uses the built-in presets.
config.backend.7z.description: 7-Zip engine for compress/decompress: bundled native 7-Zip ZS by default; system install or WASM selectable. Native is faster and uses less memory than WASM.
config.backend.7z.auto: Bundled 7-Zip ZS; system 7-Zip only when at least as capable; otherwise WASM.
config.backend.7z.native: Always system 7-Zip (error if missing or too old).
config.backend.7z.bundled: Always the bundled 7-Zip; WASM fallback if unavailable for this platform.
config.backend.7z.wasm: Always the WASM engine, never native.
config.backend.zstd.native: Always system zstd (error if not installed).
config.backend.brotli.native: Node.js built-in zlib — native, no WASM heap.
config.backend.rar.description: RAR5 creation engine: native binding (faster, less memory) or WASM fallback.
config.backend.rar.native: Always the native binding (error if unavailable).
config.backend.snappy.description: Snappy engine for tar.sz: native addon (faster) or WASM fallback.
config.backend.snappy.native: Always the native addon (error if unavailable).
config.backend.wasmTar.description: How the inner tar is written for wrapped formats (tar.gz, …) on the WASM path. Native engines always use 7-Zip.
config.backend.wasmTar.auto: Follow the engine choice: native writes the tar; else WASM streams it with node-tar.
config.backend.wasmTar.node-tar: Always stream with node-tar, even when 7-Zip could write it.
config.backend.wasmTar.wasm: Let 7zz-WASM write the tar (PAX headers); input is copied into its virtual FS (~input size in memory).
config.compression.method.description: Compression method for new 7z archives. FLZMA2 (default): LZMA2-compatible, 20–100% faster. LZMA2: widest portability. ZSTD/Brotli/LZ4/Lizard need the bundled ZS build. For xz, FLZMA2 uses the fast HC4 variant.
config.compression.method.flzma2: Fast LZMA2 (default) — LZMA2-compatible, 20–100% faster (HC4 for xz).
config.compression.method.lzma2: Stock LZMA2 — widest compatibility, best ratio.
config.compression.method.zstd: Zstandard — very fast; needs a ZS build (bundled/WASM support it).
config.compression.method.brotli: Brotli — best ratio for text; needs the bundled ZS.
config.compression.method.deflate: Deflate — the ZIP-family method; wide compatibility.
config.compression.method.bzip2: BZip2 — classic block compressor; slower, good ratio.
config.compression.method.lizard: Lizard — very fast decompression (levels map to LizardMT 10–49).
config.compression.solid.description: Pack new 7z/RAR5 archives as one solid block: smaller, but extracting/adding/deleting a file recompresses the whole block. Off (default): a bit larger, but edits stay instant and single-file extraction is fast.
config.worker.memoryMb.description: Memory ceiling (MiB) for the WASM worker thread; 0 disables the guard.
config.worker.poolSize.description: Archive worker threads: 1 serializes (lowest memory), 2 allows parallel batch ops. Requires a window reload.
config.log.level.description: Verbosity of the Smart Archiver output channel logs.
config.log.historyBytes.description: Memory budget (bytes) for the log history buffer (re-render on level change).
config.cache.maxPreviewMB.description: Largest file (MB) the preview cache holds; larger previews use the session temp dir. 0 disables the cache.
config.cache.ttlDays.description: Days a cached preview survives without being previewed again.
config.cache.maxMB.description: Total disk budget (MB) for the preview cache.
config.cache.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files in the preview cache.
